info.title: Able OS Cockpit
info.description: Read-only Able OS data for Raj's desk pages. Every call is a plain GET read - nothing can be changed through this API. Tools this key may read (11): occupancy_status (Hometown Meadows lots by status, occupancy %, inspections), rent_status (this month: charged, collected, collection %, lots past grace, whether late fees are paused), lot_roll (per lot number: status, rent, owed, last paid, open jobs, next inspection), work_order_list (open jobs by lot), dates_list (critical dates, open documents, scheduled inspections), work_order_status (repairs by status and priority, emergencies, parts), documents_and_dates (documents by stage, critical dates overdue / due this week), applicant_queue (open rental applicants by stage, no names), ellery_desk (applicant counts, AHTX properties and doors, dates), rex_units (AHTX vacant homes: address, beds, baths, size, asking rent, pets - never codes), qbo_sync_status (whether QuickBooks is up to date - status only). Each answer is {tool, data} and data carries an as_of time where the tool has one. No names, phones, emails, codes or screening results are ever returned.

get.summary: Read one Able OS cockpit tool (read-only)
get.description: GET /api/mcp?tool=rent_status returns {"tool":"rent_status","data":{...}}. Without ?tool it lists the tools this key may read. A tool this key may not read answers 403.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Which tool to read. Leave empty to list them.

200.description: {tool, data} - data is the tool's answer.

403.description: That tool is not available to this key.
